description: Neo.mjs is a multi-threaded application engine — the Body of a self-evolving software organism — with object permanence, worker isolation, JSON-first UIs, and zero-build native ES modules.
rules: End every class with Neo.setupClass(MyClass); put setup logic in construct(config) and call super.construct(config) first; never write a JS constructor().
Define reactive configs inside static config = { myProp_: defaultValue } with a trailing underscore and implement beforeGetMyProp, beforeSetMyProp, or afterSetMyProp hooks as needed.
Batch multiple reactive config updates using instance.set({ propA: 1, propB: 2 }) so every hook sees all new values and effects pause for the batch.
Components, state.Provider, and data.Store run inside the Application Worker; never access window, document, or raw DOM nodes directly in component code.
Route DOM measurements through Neo.main.DomAccess (e.g. component.getDomRect()), DOM events through domListeners, and other browser APIs through Neo.main.addon.* bridges.
Bind data-driven UI components to a Neo.data.Store of Neo.data.Model records or a view-root Neo.state.Provider rather than hand-mapping raw arrays.
